query:
INSERT INTO notes (text, owner, state, predecessor_id)
VALUES (
    COALESCE(?, ""), 
    ?, 
    ?, 
    (SELECT id FROM (
        SELECT id, state FROM notes
    ) AS n1
    WHERE state = ? 
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM (
            SELECT predecessor_id, state FROM notes
        ) AS n2
        WHERE n2.predecessor_id = n1.id 
        AND n2.state = n1.state
    ))
)
